overview: The Public Health and Community Safety Committee met to discuss and ultimately approved a draft ordinance regarding law enforcement identification and masking restrictions.

items.title: Resolution 26031: Ordinance Requiring Law Enforcement Identification and Restricting Masking
items.summary: The committee discussed and approved a proposed ordinance restricting law enforcement officers from wearing masks except under specific exemptions, requiring visible identification, and establishing protocols for verifying the credentials of other law enforcement agencies.
